name: world.bufo/store
title: bufo.world
description: Search 3,000+ bufos, download the free PNG art, price carts with US/CA shipping, and check out.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the bufo.world catalog of bufo frog designs by words (moods, snacks, jobs, sayings, or what the picture shows) and/or a collection. Returns designs whose name matches in storefront order (most-ordered first, then A-Z), then designs whose description matches, each with its slug, emoji shortcode, a one-sentence description of the picture, image, product URL and starting price. An empty query lists every design. Next step: get_product for formats and prices, or download_image for the free PNG.

query.description: Words to match, e.g. "coffee", "sad", "pizza". Empty = all designs.

collection.description: Only designs in this collection (ids from list_collections).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Details for one design: every format family in brief (name, price range, option values, package and every variant id), full variants for one family (variant id, options, USD and CAD price, shipping package group, image, product page URL; stickers unless you pass family), a ready add-to-cart link, the shipping rates per package, and the optional printed :slug: label (available on every format). Prices are fixed and identical for every design.

slug.description: Exact design slug from search_products, e.g. "bufo-chef".

market.description: US (default) or CA: which country the product page URLs show prices for. Both prices are always listed.

family.description: Which format family to list in full: sticker, tee, hoodie, tote, mug, glass, bottle, buttons, decal, desk, clock, cards. Default sticker.

tools.name: download_image
tools.description: The free PNG of one or more designs: a direct download link to the full-resolution art with a transparent background (about 1,500 px), plus the emoji shortcode, a one-sentence description of the picture and a smaller preview image. Pass embed_previews to also receive the previews as images in this result (first 4 designs). The PNGs are free for personal, non-commercial use.

slugs.description: Exact design slugs from search_products, e.g. ["bufo-chef"]. At most 20.

embed_previews.description: Also attach the preview images (not the full PNGs) to the result, for the first 4 designs. Default false.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: The themed collections (e.g. work, snacks, feelings) with ids, names, design counts and cover images. Pass an id to search_products as collection to list its designs.

tools.name: quote_cart
tools.description: Price a cart exactly as the bufo.world cart and Stripe Checkout will: line prices, merchandise subtotal, shipping per package group (each group ships separately; some US sticker packages ship free from US$20) and the total before tax. Unknown or invalid items are listed in rejected with the reason.

shortcode_label.description: Print the :slug: label under the art (only variants with shortcode_label_available). Default false.

items.description: Cart lines, at most 50; at most 50 items in total.

country.description: Shipping country: US (prices in USD) or CA (prices in CAD).

tools.name: create_cart_link
tools.description: Build a bufo.world link that fills the shopper's cart with these items when they open it in their browser; they review it and pay on Stripe Checkout. Returns the link, its quote and any rejected items. Creates no order and charges nothing; give the link to the shopper.

shortcode_label.description: Print the :slug: label under the art (only variants with shortcode_label_available). Default false.

items.description: Cart lines, at most 50; at most 50 items in total.

country.description: CA prices the cart in CAD for a Canadian shopper; default US.

mode.description: add (default): add to whatever is in their cart. replace: replace their cart with these items.

tools.name: checkout_with_link
tools.description: For an agent that has the shopper's Link wallet connected (Stripe's Link CLI or Link MCP server): everything needed to buy a cart for them through Stripe's hosted agentic checkout. Returns bufo.world's Stripe business id, the catalog item id of every line, the quote, and the Link commands to create the checkout, request a one-time payment token (the shopper approves it in Link) and complete the order. Creates no order and charges nothing itself. Without Link, use create_cart_link.

shortcode_label.description: Print the :slug: label under the art (only variants with shortcode_label_available). Default false.

items.description: Cart lines, at most 50; at most 50 items in total.

country.description: Where the order ships: US (charged in USD) or CA (charged in CAD).
